structuredBinding.serializerFailure: After a structured object attribute is written, a later mutation reparses the Svelte expression as a string and renders it as quoted JSON. Multiple structured attributes cannot coexist reliably.

progress.falsePositive: Missing Image and Text source bindings are treated as complete because no invalid non-empty binding remains.

issues: Hero title, subtitle and button collide at desktop and mobile widths.
Dark cards collapse their placeholder content into an incoherent row.
No NASA image or real feed text is rendered.

rootCauses.cause: frontAstParseAttributes stores a braced object expression as text; the next render quotes that text because it is no longer an object.
rootCauses.consequence: Every unrelated insertion can invalidate previously valid structured bindings.

rootCauses.cause: The palette still inserts source as the legacy string [] even though the frontbuilder built-in descriptor now uses a literal FlowValueBinding.
rootCauses.consequence: The agent must immediately replace the palette payload with a picker mutation.

rootCauses.cause: It validates present bindings but does not require data-capable Image/Text blocks under a backend iterator to have a source.
rootCauses.consequence: The incomplete placeholder UI reports 100 percent and no binding warning.

rootCauses.cause: Navigation and subsequent read-only calls wedged; independent Playwright using domcontentloaded completed in under two seconds.
rootCauses.consequence: The fresh agent could not perform browser validation itself.

comparison.interpretation: P0 made schema-backed structured binding the natural agent choice and rejected string workarounds, but exposed a persistence defect that more than doubled MCP calls and prevented functional rendering.
